sources.title: PayPal digital wallet (consumer app overview) [brief S15]
sources.page_scope: US consumer app marketing overview with Pay Later footnotes
sources.claim: App lets users send/request money, shop offers, view balances, purchases, deliveries, payments and subscriptions in real time, use crypto, Savings and PayPal Debit Card, pool money, follow packages on a map. Footnotes: Pay in 4 $30-$1,500, not available to MO residents, soft credit check, 18+, lender PayPal, Inc. (NMLS 910457); Pay Monthly lender WebBank, fixed APR 9.99-35.99%, not available AK/CT/HI/WA, serviced by Bill Me Later, Inc. (NMLS 2296861); in-store single-use card valid 24 hours.
caveats: Pay in 4 range ($30-$1,500) and Pay Monthly APR floor (9.99%) contradict CR-PP-03 ($10-$2,000; 0-35.99%).
No visible update date; securepayments.paypal.com host is a PayPal-owned mirror of paypal.com/us/digital-wallet.
sources.local_note: Pay in 4: $30 to $1,500, not available to residents of MO, soft credit check; Pay Monthly: WebBank lender, Fixed APR 9.99-35.99%, not available AK, CT, HI, WA.

sources.title: What are the benefits of PayPal's apps and how do I download them? [brief S16]
sources.page_scope: Help article comparing PayPal consumer app, Business app and POS app
sources.claim: Consumer PayPal app: send and request money, shop in-store or online, manage bank and card info, get rewards and discounts where available. Business app and POS app are separate products (invoices, refunds, POS acceptance).
caveats: Separates consumer app from business/POS apps; business features are out of scope for consumer parity.
Read via WebFetch summary; availability varies by country.
sources.local_note: PayPal app: send and request money; shop in-store or online; manage bank and card info; get rewards and discounts (where available).

sources.title: Buy Now, Pay Later (Pay in 4 and Pay Monthly)
sources.page_scope: US Pay Later product page with legal footnotes
sources.claim: Pay in 4: $10-$2,000, 4 interest-free biweekly payments, no late or sign-up fees, soft credit check may be needed, not available to MO residents, 18+, lender PayPal, Inc. (NMLS 910457), CA Financing Law license, RI small loan lender. Pay Monthly: $49-$10,000, 3/6/12/24 months, $0 down, Fixed APR 0-35.99%, no late or sign-up fees, no prepayment penalty, not available AK/CT/HI/WA, lender WebBank, servicing Bill Me Later, Inc.; representative examples at 26% APR ($200/3 mo = $208.68 total; $600/6 mo = $646.57; $600/12 mo = $688.01; $1,500/24 mo = $1,938.47). Missed payments may impact credit score.
caveats: CONTRADICTION with CR-PP-01 and CR-PP-04 on Pay in 4 range and Pay Monthly APR floor.
No visible update date.
sources.local_note: Pay in 4 $10 to $2,000, not available to residents of MO; Pay Monthly Fixed APR is 0-35.99%, not available AK, CT, HI or WA; lender WebBank; 26% APR examples incl. $1,500 over 24 months = $1,938.47.

sources.title: Paying with PayPal (checkout)
sources.page_scope: US consumer checkout page with FAQ and footnotes
sources.claim: Pay in store, online, or over time; store payment methods; split payment across two methods; Pay Later without late fees; package tracking across UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS and 800+ carriers whether or not paid with PayPal; card-compromise alerts. Footnote 1: Pay in 4 $30-$1,500, not available to MO or NV residents. Footnote 2: Pay Monthly fixed APR 9.99-35.99%.
caveats: CONTRADICTION: footnote lists MO and NV as excluded for Pay in 4, while CR-PP-01/03/31 list only MO.
No visible update date.
sources.local_note: Pay in 4 ... $30 to $1,500. Pay in 4 is currently not available to residents of MO or NV. Pay Monthly Fixed APR is 9.99-35.99%. Use two payment methods at checkout.

sources.title: What is Pay in 4? (help463)
sources.page_scope: US help article on Pay in 4 eligibility, fees, schedule
sources.claim: Pay in 4 shows for carts $10-$2,000; decision in seconds; availability depends on state of residence; 18+; account in good standing; no sign-up, application, late or NSF fees; loan lasts a little over 6 weeks; first payment at purchase, 3 autopay repayments every 2 weeks; non-USD purchases converted to USD with conversion charges; loan agreement shown during application.
caveats: Range here ($10-$2,000) matches CR-PP-03 but not CR-PP-01/04.
sources.local_note: PayPal does not charge any sign-up, application, late, or non-sufficient funds (NSF) fees ... Pay in 4 ... cart values between $10 and $2,000.

sources.title: Questions about Pay in 4 repayments (help1099)
sources.page_scope: US help article on Pay in 4 repayment mechanics
sources.claim: Repayments via bank, debit card or credit card (Capital One, Citibank, Chase credit cards excluded); balance only for one-time manual repayments; extra/early payoff with no penalty; cut-off 11:59 p.m. ET day before due date when autopay on; cannot pause/skip; missed repayment makes loan past due, triggers reminders, may affect future Pay Later eligibility; repayments continue during disputes; chargeback on a repayment makes loan past due.
sources.local_note: Capital One, Citibank, and Chase credit cards cannot be used for repayments ... you cannot pause, suspend, or skip your repayments ... no penalty fees for paying off the balance early.

sources.title: What is Pay Monthly? (help839)
sources.page_scope: US help article on Pay Monthly terms and management
sources.claim: Pay Monthly: $49-$10,000, 3-24 months, issued by WebBank, fixed APR 9.99%-35.99% based on creditworthiness, lower promotional APRs possible; eligibility varies by user/state/merchant; 18+ (or age of majority); WebBank TILA disclosure and loan agreement shown on approval; first payment one month after merchant processes order; payments by ACH or debit card (autopay or manual), balance only manual, no credit cards; manage in Pay Later section; one loan per purchase.
caveats: CONTRADICTION: APR floor 9.99% here vs 0% on CR-PP-03.
sources.local_note: Pay Monthly ... issued by PayPal's bank partner, WebBank, with a fixed APR ranging from 9.99% - 35.99%. Credit cards aren't accepted as a repayment option.

sources.title: How does the Pay Monthly installment loan appear on my credit report? (help851)
sources.page_scope: US help article on Pay Monthly credit reporting (body not retrievable)
sources.claim: No claim supported: page returned only Help Center navigation (HTTP 206 / empty body) to curl and WebFetch on www and history.paypal.com hosts.
caveats: Content not retrievable; credit-inquiry type (soft vs hard) and bureau reporting for Pay Monthly remain unverified from official sources.
sources.local_note: Article body not returned; only Help Center navigation visible.

sources.title: PayPal Consumer Fees
sources.page_scope: US consumer fee schedule
sources.claim: Buying: no fee unless currency conversion. Domestic personal send: balance/bank free; cards 2.90% + fixed fee (USD $0.30); Amex Send free. International personal send: +5.00% (min $0.99, max $4.99). Receiving personal: free unless conversion. Conversion spread 4.00% for purchases/sends in other currency, 3.00% all other. Withdrawals: standard free; Instant to bank or card 1.75% (min $0.25, max $25); instant-to-bank limit $25,000/txn; card withdrawals $5,000/txn/day/week, $15,000/month; paper check $1.50 (personal accounts without Balance account). Card link/confirmation $1.95 refunded. Crypto buy/sell 2.20%/2.00%/1.80%/1.50% by amount tiers; external transfer network fee; 1% (non-PYUSD) or 1.5% (PYUSD) on one-step external wallet transfers.
caveats: Legacy URL /us/webapps/mpp/paypal-fees redirects here.
Fees may change; Ukraine fee waiver banner present.
sources.local_note: Last Updated: May 19, 2026. Cards 2.90% + fixed fee; international 5.00% min 0.99 USD max 4.99 USD; conversion spread 4.00%/3.00%; Instant 1.75% min 0.25 USD max 25.00 USD.

sources.title: PayPal User Agreement
sources.page_scope: US PayPal account user agreement (personal and business)
sources.claim: Personal vs business accounts; link/unlink payment methods; card confirmation $1.95 charge refunded; manual bank link uses two deposits under $1.00 plus one debit, or real-time verification; account statements (two statements when Balance account linked); automatic payments cancellable 3 Business Days before next payment via settings, Help Center or (888) 221-1161; loyalty cards storable in app; Rewards Program by reference; Purchase Protection program incorporated; unauthorized transactions must be reported within 60 days of statement; paper check $1.50 for personal accounts without Balance account.
caveats: Very long page; read via local text extraction of fetched HTML.
sources.local_note: Last updated on September 14, 2026. Two small deposits of less than $1.00 each; card confirmation $1.95 refunded; cancel automatic payment 3 Business Days before; report unauthorized within 60 days.

sources.title: PayPal's Purchase Protection Program
sources.page_scope: US buyer Purchase Protection terms
sources.claim: Covers Item Not Received and Significantly Not as Described; full purchase price plus original shipping; return shipping not covered; long ineligible list (real estate, vehicles, cash equivalents/gift cards, gold, financial products, NFTs, gambling, donations, government payments, bill pay, direct-debit via Balance routing numbers, custom-made items for SNAD, in-person pickup for INR, PayPal World QR in person, Payouts, personal/F&F payments, resale items). Steps: contact seller, open dispute in Resolution Center, escalate to claim within 20 days (may need to wait 7 days from transaction), respond to document requests, return item if asked. Windows: INR within 180 days of payment; SNAD within 30 days of delivery or 180 days of payment, whichever sooner. Possible temporary refund with 5 business days notice before recovery. Card chargeback and PayPal claim are mutually exclusive.
caveats: The '180-day claim window' cited in the brief applies fully only to INR; SNAD is the sooner of 30 days after delivery or 180 days.
Legacy URL /us/webapps/mpp/ua/buyer-protection serves identical content.
sources.local_note: Last updated on January 26, 2026. INR: within 180 days of the date you sent the payment. SNAD: within 30 days of delivery or within 180 days, whichever is sooner. Escalate within 20 days.

sources.title: How do I open a dispute with a seller? (help160)
sources.page_scope: US help article on Resolution Center dispute flow
sources.claim: Resolution Center > Report a Problem > select payment > reason (unauthorized activity, purchase issues, seller issues, billing errors/subscriptions); message the other party; escalate to claim (often after 7 days from payment); disputes auto-close after 20 days unless escalated; closed disputes cannot be reopened.
caveats: The smarthelp FAQ1344 URL redirected to this same article.
sources.local_note: Go to the Resolution Center and click Report a Problem ... A dispute will automatically close after 20 days unless it's been escalated.

sources.title: PayPal Balance Terms and Conditions (incl. Long Form Disclosure)
sources.page_scope: US PayPal Balance account terms and fee disclosure
sources.claim: Balance account features: hold balance, send, buy, debit card, ATM, transfer to/from PayPal Savings, Direct Deposit with The Bancorp Bank, N.A. account/routing numbers (no fee, early access may be offered), add cash at stores $20-$500 per transaction, remote check capture. FDIC pass-through only if debit card opened, Direct Deposit enrolled, or crypto bought/received; otherwise unsecured claim against PayPal. Long Form fees: international send 5% ($0.99-$4.99); add cash $3.74-$3.95; check reload 2% (payroll/government) or 5% (other), min $6; instant transfer 1.75% ($0.25-$25); debit card out-of-network ATM $2.50, international ATM $2.50, foreign transaction 2.50%.
sources.local_note: Last updated on September 14, 2026. Add cash $20.00 to $500.00 per transaction; fee $3.74 - $3.95; check reload 2.00%/5.00% (minimum $6); FDIC pass-through only for debit card, Direct Deposit or crypto users.

sources.title: Earn interest with PayPal Savings
sources.page_scope: US PayPal Savings product page
sources.claim: PayPal Savings provided by Synchrony Bank, Member FDIC; 3.55% APY as of September 30, 2026, variable and can change after opening; no minimums or fees; Balance account required; add from balance, linked debit card, or bank; goals and recurring auto-save; FDIC coverage up to $250,000 at Synchrony aggregated across Synchrony deposits.
caveats: APY date is the rate as-of date, not page update date; APY is variable.
'9x the national average' compares to FDIC national rate as of Sept 21, 2026.
sources.local_note: As of September 30, 2026, the annual percentage yield (APY) for PayPal Savings is 3.55%. Variable rate. PayPal Savings is provided by Synchrony Bank, Member FDIC.

sources.title: PayPal Savings FAQs (help777)
sources.page_scope: US help FAQ for PayPal Savings
sources.claim: Personal US accounts only; Balance account required; goals; Smart Route splits Direct Deposit between Balance and Savings; Low Balance Reload from Savings; transfers out must go to Balance first; holds may affect access; statements and 1099-INT only on web (1099-INT if >= $10 interest across Synchrony deposits); denied applicants may reapply after 30 days; closure via customer service up to 3 days; Synchrony cannot answer PayPal Savings questions.
sources.local_note: PayPal Savings is currently only available for PayPal personal accounts in the US ... statements are not available on the PayPal app ... re-apply after 30 days.

sources.title: PayPal Debit Card
sources.page_scope: US PayPal Debit Mastercard product page and FAQ
sources.claim: Issued by The Bancorp Bank, N.A.; no monthly fee, no minimum balance, no credit check; requires personal account in good standing, confirmed US address, DOB, SSN, only one PayPal account per SSN; virtual card immediately, physical on request; 5% back on up to $1,000/month in chosen category (Groceries, Restaurants, Fuel, Apparel, Rideshare & Public Transit); free MoneyPass ATMs, $2.50 otherwise, $400 daily limit; 2.5% foreign transaction fee; temporary card lock; Apple/Google/Samsung Pay; Mastercard Zero Liability, extended warranty (AIG), $250 satisfaction guarantee, optional ID theft protection (Generali); Direct Deposit up to 2 days early; add cash at 90,000+ retailers up to $3.95 fee.
sources.local_note: 5% back on up to $1,000 of selected category spend per month ... Up to $400 USD daily withdrawal limit ... non-MoneyPass ATMs have a $2.50 fee ... issued by The Bancorp Bank, N.A.

sources.title: PayPal Rewards
sources.page_scope: US PayPal Rewards and offers page
sources.claim: Discover 1%/2%/5% offers from brands in the app, auto-applied at PayPal checkout, stackable; no separate enrollment; 100 points = $1; redeem at checkout, into balance, donate, or roll into PayPal Savings; PayPal Cashback Mastercard (Synchrony) 3% on PayPal purchases, 1.5% elsewhere, no annual fee, hard inquiry if approved, 18+ US.
caveats: PayPal may earn a commission on offers.
sources.local_note: 100 PayPal Rewards points = $1 redemption value. Offers are subject to availability ... An approved PayPal Cashback Mastercard application will result in a hard credit inquiry.

sources.title: PayPal Rewards Program Agreement
sources.page_scope: US Rewards Program terms
sources.claim: Individuals, US residents, 18+; points only on eligible USD purchases; points pending 1-14 days, up to 90 days; points expire unless account open, in good standing and active (e.g., earn at least 10 points per 365-day period); Honey account can be linked to combine points.
sources.local_note: Last updated on March 17, 2025. Points may remain pending for up to 90 days ... Earning at least 10 Points ... within each consecutive 365-day period.

sources.title: Subscriptions
sources.page_scope: US subscription management page
sources.claim: In the app: link and manage existing subscriptions, add new ones, update payment method for multiple subscriptions at once, view payment methods and payment history; Subscriptions under Manage finances menu; may take hours to appear, check Linked Businesses.
caveats: Covers only subscriptions paid with PayPal; app-only per page.
sources.local_note: Update your payment information for multiple subscriptions all at once ... View payment methods and track payment history for all your subscriptions.

sources.title: Add cards and banks to PayPal
sources.page_scope: US page on linking payment methods
sources.claim: Add Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express cards or bank accounts via Accounts > Add Banks and Cards; choose method at checkout; Pay with Rewards lets eligible credit card rewards be used at PayPal checkout (issuer terms); Debit Card requires Balance account.
sources.local_note: With PayPal, you can add one or more payment methods such as your Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express card or bank account.

sources.title: Send money online
sources.page_scope: US send money page and FAQ
sources.claim: Send by name, phone, email, handle or PayPal link; choose Friends and Family or Goods and Services; send gifts with card theme; send between PayPal and Venmo; free domestic with balance or bank; cards 2.9% + $0.30; international to 110+ countries, Xoom for more delivery options.
sources.local_note: It's free to send money domestically to friends and family using your PayPal balance or bank account. Money sent from a credit or debit card will incur a 2.9% transaction fee plus a $0.30 flat fee.

sources.title: Request and receive money
sources.page_scope: US request money page and FAQ
sources.claim: Request via contact or shareable PayPal link (created in app), username or QR code; send/receive across PayPal and Venmo; split purchases or pool money; email confirmation needed to request; received money lands in balance (Balance account required to hold balance).
sources.local_note: Request money directly with a PayPal link ... Or share your PayPal username or QR code. Send and receive payments across Venmo and PayPal.

sources.title: Send money internationally
sources.page_scope: US international transfers page (PayPal and Xoom)
sources.claim: Send to PayPal accounts in 110+ countries; Xoom (separate Xoom account required) to 160+ countries with cash pickup/delivery, bank, mobile wallet, mobile reload; cross-border fees paid by sender or recipient; track transfers in Activity.
caveats: Xoom fees/limits not on this page.
sources.local_note: Easily send money to people in 110+ countries ... send to 160+ countries using our Xoom service. *An account with Xoom is required.

sources.title: Pool money
sources.page_scope: US pool money product page (live on 2026-10-10)
sources.claim: Create a pool (name, description, end date, optional goal), share link, contributors need not have PayPal (card contributions, fees apply), anonymous contributions visible to creator, track progress, transfer to balance free, standard bank transfer free, instant transfer fee; organizer needs PayPal Balance account and ID check; pool open up to one year in US; no charity/fundraising use.
caveats: Pools page is live in the US as of observation date, i.e., the current product is NOT discontinued; the legacy Money Pools program was retired in 2021 (see CR-PP-27).
sources.local_note: A PayPal Balance account is required to create a pool ... A pool can be open for up to one year in the US. You cannot use a pool to raise money for charity.

sources.title: What are pools? (help1197)
sources.page_scope: US help article on pools
sources.claim: Create via Send > Pool or web Send & Request > pool money; max $20,000 collected per pool; 5 active pools per person; identity verified and account in good standing; all money belongs to creator; contributions in primary currency; extend end date up to one year; report pool.
sources.local_note: You can collect a maximum of $20,000 per pool, with a limit of 5 active pools per person.

sources.title: PayPal Pool Terms and Conditions
sources.page_scope: US Pool service terms
sources.claim: Pool is a subaccount of the creator's PayPal Balance account; not a bank/savings account, no interest; no fee to create; contributions are personal transactions with consumer fee schedule; contributors bear risk (personal payments, not purchases); prohibited uses include charity and offering perks.
caveats: Requested via /us/webapps/mpp/ua/pool-tnc which redirected here.
sources.local_note: Last updated on November 14, 2024. Pool is a service ... to create a subaccount of your PayPal Balance Account ... We don't charge fees to create a pool.

sources.title: Nutzungsbedingungen fuer PayPal MoneyPools (Switzerland, legacy)
sources.page_scope: Legacy Money Pools terms (Swiss market) with discontinuation notice
sources.claim: Legacy MoneyPools program discontinued 8 November 2021; new pool creation disabled 30 September 2021; open pools expired 30 October 2021.
caveats: Swiss (CH) page in German; the equivalent US legacy URL (/us/webapps/mpp/ua/moneypool-tnc) now redirects to the US legal hub home, so the US legacy retirement notice itself was not observed.
Shows that 'Pools discontinued' reports refer to the 2021 legacy program; the current US Pool service (CR-PP-24/26) is live.
sources.local_note: Am 8. November 2021 stellt PayPal sein MoneyPools-Programm und die Dienste ein. Neue MoneyPools ab 30. September 2021 deaktiviert.

sources.title: Crypto like a pro with PayPal
sources.page_scope: US consumer crypto page
sources.claim: Buy, sell, send, receive and spend crypto (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, PYUSD and more); checkout with crypto; PYUSD rewards 'could earn 4%' (rate as of today, subject to change); crypto services by PayPal Digital, Inc. (NYDFS limited purpose trust, NMLS 2610315); custody by Paxos Trust Company; tax 1099 forms on sales.
caveats: 4% PYUSD reward rate is 'as of today' and variable.
sources.local_note: You could earn 4% for holding PYUSD in your PayPal wallet. PayPal Digital, Inc. (NMLS ID: 2610315) ... Custody ... Paxos Trust Company, N.A.

sources.title: Cryptocurrency Terms and Conditions
sources.page_scope: US crypto account terms (PayPal Digital, Inc.)
sources.claim: Consumer Crypto Account requires personal PayPal account plus PayPal Balance account in good standing (or Venmo personal); KYC name, address, DOB, TIN; purchases funded by balance, bank or debit card (no credit cards/credit products); recurring buys; send/receive internally by username/phone/email and to/from external wallets; PYUSD rewards program requires holding at least 1.0 PYUSD; crypto not FDIC/SIPC insured; unauthorized crypto transfers must be reported within 60 days.
caveats: Terms do not list excluded states in the sections read; state disclosures section exists but not fully reviewed.
sources.local_note: Last updated on May 19, 2026. We do not currently allow use of a credit card or other credit products ... to purchase Crypto Assets.

sources.title: What can I do with PayPal package tracking? (help999)
sources.page_scope: US help article on package tracking
sources.claim: App-only feature; automatic tracking by linking Gmail or Outlook; manual tracking by tracking number and carrier; statuses Prepping/Shipped/Out for delivery/Delivered/Waiting for info/Check carrier; In Progress and Delivered lists; push notifications if opted in; merchant-shared tracking for some PayPal purchases; works whether or not paid with PayPal.
sources.local_note: It's exclusive to the PayPal app ... link your email to Package tracking ... Enter the tracking number and carrier, and we'll provide live updates.

sources.title: PayPal - Pay, Send, Save (Apple App Store listing)
sources.page_scope: US iOS App Store listing by developer PayPal, Inc.
sources.claim: Developer PayPal, Inc.; 4.8 stars, 6.3M ratings; #3 Finance; features: Purchase Protection, debit card 5% category rewards, send to 110+ countries, Pay Later (Pay in 4 $10-$2,000, not available to MO residents), package tracking (not all sellers participate), subscriptions, new Me Tab; latest version 10.5.2 dated Oct 2.
caveats: Version date shown without year; assumed 2026 given version sequence.
sources.local_note: Pay in 4 is available upon approval for purchases of $10 - $2000 and is currently not available to residents of MO. 10.5.2 Oct 2.

sources.title: How PayPal works
sources.page_scope: US overview page with security footnotes
sources.claim: Tracking, alerts, security features; early fraud alerts limited to unusual activity in PayPal accounts and PayPal's online merchant network (not PayPal-branded cards); Purchase Protection on eligible purchases; FDIC pass-through conditions for Balance funds; PayPal Cashback Mastercard issued by Synchrony Bank.
sources.local_note: Early fraud alerts are limited to unusual activity detected in PayPal accounts and within PayPal's online merchant network.
